environment.name: USERLAND_API_KEY
environment.description: The API key to use, ahead of the saved credentials file.

environment.name: USERLAND_API_BASE_URL
environment.description: The API to call; https only (http only for localhost).

environment.description: The selected business when --account isn't given, ahead of the saved one.

environment.description: The console that sign-in links must point at.

environment.name: USERLAND_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environment.description: Where credentials are saved instead of ~/.userland/credentials.json.
